corpus: fusion-expansion (manifest.json sha256-verified at measurement time); dbt-fusion 2.0.0-preview.218, duckdb 1.11.0
line_splitting: Python bytes.splitlines(keepends=True) on raw bytes; line numbers 1-based; paths relative to captures/fusion-expansion

label_semantics.keep: must survive filtering (actual result, count, warning, diagnostic, or unknown/ambiguous text)
label_semantics.noise: demonstrated routine startup/progress/formatting line, safe to remove as a whole line

ansi_crlf_handling: PTY capture labeled on bytes.splitlines records (CRLF and ANSI stay attached to their line); kept lines are emitted byte-for-byte with no ANSI stripping or newline normalization; tokens use ceil(bytes/4) on raw bytes
review_status: Parent-directed agent labeling for phase0-expansion; not user-approved policy or production filter
review_change: Kept lines inside the Errors-and-Warnings stderr block, including an interior blank line, and the block heading itself; noise limited to startup banner, profile-loading notice, blank separators and Execution Summary decoration; ANSI/CRLF preserved on kept PTY lines.
